title: Global convergence of Morse-potential diffusion on compact Riemannian manifolds of dimension at least two under the Hessian drift threshold
author: Laurent Miclo
work: On the convergence of global-optimization fraudulent stochastic algorithms
difficulty_reason: The result controls almost-sure capture by every global Morse minimum for a degenerate diffusion with an anisotropic Hessian threshold. The proof derives a time-changed non-Markov potential process, establishes localized Bessel comparisons and positive capture probabilities, then combines them through global elliptic returns and a uniform strong-Markov regeneration argument. The fractional-potential extension attains the exact threshold and the positive probability of every minimum in dimension at least2, beyond ordinary doctoral stochastic analysis qualifiers.
